aside.registeredBody: Sign in to use your saved details.

benefits.track: Watch an order from the payment through to the doorstep
benefits.addresses: Keep addresses on file and get through checkout faster
benefits.saved: Save pieces to come back to later

meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to pick up your Wrenpaw order history, saved items and stored addresses.

login.title: Sign in
login.checkoutHint: Sign in and checkout arrives pre-filled from your saved details. Your bag stays as it is.
login.failed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

meta.title: Create an account
meta.description: Open a Wrenpaw account to track orders and keep a delivery address on file.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Three short steps. We need these to deliver to you and to confirm you are old enough to order.
register.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}
register.restricted: Accounts and deliveries are not available in {countries}.
register.terms: I have read the <link>Terms and Conditions</link> and accept them
register.privacy: Your details are treated as the <link>Privacy policy</link> describes.
register.failed: We couldn't create your account. Please try again.

meta.title: Reset your password
meta.description: Ask us for a link that lets you set a new Wrenpaw password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Give us the email address on the account and a link to set a new password follows.
forgot.sent: Where an account exists under {email}, a reset link is now on its way. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Try the spam folder.
forgot.failed: We couldn't send the link. Please try again.

meta.title: Set a new password
meta.description: Set the new password for your Wrenpaw account here.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.invalidTitle: That reset link has either run out or been used already
reset.invalidBody: Ask for a fresh one and use it inside the window the email states.
reset.doneBody: Your new password is set. Sign in with it from now on.
reset.failed: We couldn't change your password. Please try again.
